_comment: Baseline for scripts/check-cycles.js — the circular-dependency ratchet.
WHY minFilesProcessed EXISTS (this is the important field):
The 2026-07-29 review found that `madge --circular src/index.ts` had been
reporting a clean green for months while resolving only 16 of 293 files.
The lib imports via the `src/…` TypeScript path alias; without --ts-config
madge cannot resolve those specifiers, silently drops them, and truthfully
reports 'no cycles' about the 5% of the graph it managed to see. A gate that
cannot fail is worse than no gate. This floor asserts the DENOMINATOR, so a
resolution regression is a hard failure instead of a green.
maxCycles is a RATCHET, in the same spirit as jest.config.js coverageThreshold:
set at the measured number so cycles cannot grow, and lowered whenever real
work removes some. Never raise it to make a build pass — that is the whole
failure mode this file exists to prevent.
On the number itself: most of these route through types/index.ts and are
ERASED at compile time (types/model.ts exports zero runtime values), so they
cost nothing at runtime. Reducing the RUNTIME ones is the valuable work.
History:
63 -> 47  2026-07-29  schemas/validation.ts imported getAllAnchors from the
`src/utils` barrel instead of `src/utils/isoMath`.
One import path; killed 16 cycles including the
confirmed runtime value cycle validation <-> utils.
Remaining confirmed runtime cycle: Axoview.tsx -> UiOverlay ->
ExportImageDialog -> Axoview (the dialog mounts a second <Axoview>). Its fix
is to load the dialog lazily, which is bundle-split work the owner has
deferred — see known_issues.md and technical-review-2026-07-29.md §5.
